clubs.name: Creative Collective
clubs.description: A space for curious minds and creative experiments. Make art, share ideas, and meet people who see things a little differently.

clubs.name: Tech & Makers Society
clubs.description: Build something that matters. Join hands-on workshops, collaborative projects, and conversations about the future of technology.

clubs.name: Campus Active
clubs.description: Movement for everyone. From friendly games to mindful mornings, find your own way to feel good and stay connected.

clubs.name: Student Social Club
clubs.description: Your next friend is one hello away. We bring students together through relaxed hangouts, games, and campus celebrations.

clubs.name: Future Ready Network
clubs.description: Explore where your degree can take you with practical skill sessions, portfolio feedback, and peer conversations.

clubs.name: Green Campus Crew
clubs.description: Small actions, shared impact. Help make campus greener through community projects and student-led volunteering.

events.title: After-hours: art & good company
events.description: An evening of colour, conversation, and creating just for the fun of it. All materials are provided; bring your curiosity. No art experience needed.

events.title: Build your first creative website
events.description: Turn an idea into an interactive web page in this beginner-friendly workshop. Bring a charged laptop; we will guide you from the first line of code.

events.title: A little fresh air: campus fun run
events.description: Start your morning with a friendly 3 km loop around campus. Walk, jog, or run at your own pace. Bring water and comfortable shoes.

events.title: Meet your people: board game night
events.description: Pull up a chair for easy-to-learn games and new connections. Come with friends or come solo; we will help you find a table.

events.title: Your next chapter: portfolio clinic
events.description: Get constructive feedback on your portfolio and practise explaining your work. Bring one project you would love to talk about.

events.title: Plant a little possibility
events.description: Join a relaxed morning of planting and caring for our campus garden. Gloves and tools are provided. Please wear covered shoes.

events.title: Open mic, open minds
events.description: An open stage for student music, poetry, and stories. Sign up to perform on arrival or settle in and support your campus creatives.

events.title: Ideas into prototypes
events.description: Work in small teams to turn everyday campus problems into useful prototypes. All disciplines and experience levels are welcome.

events.title: Reset & recharge: mindful movement
events.description: Take a gentle pause with guided stretching and breathing. Bring a mat or towel, and choose the movements that feel right for you.

events.title: The big campus quiz
events.description: Gather a team or join one at the door for an evening of friendly trivia. Expect a mix of music, culture, science, and campus surprises.

events.title: Speak with confidence
events.description: Practise introductions, interviews, and short presentations in a supportive group. Leave with practical techniques you can use straight away.

events.title: Campus clean-up & coffee
events.description: Give an hour to a cleaner campus, then share a coffee with fellow volunteers. Equipment is provided. Bring a reusable cup.

events.title: Sketchbook Sunday
events.description: Explore everyday details through quick sketches and relaxed creative prompts. Paper and pencils are available, or bring your own sketchbook.

events.title: Make it work: coding social
events.description: Bring a project, a tricky bug, or just an idea. Meet other student developers and work together in a friendly, low-pressure space.

events.title: Friendly five-a-side
events.description: An inclusive afternoon of short football matches. Teams are formed on arrival, and beginners are encouraged to join.

events.title: Sunset picnic on the green
events.description: Slow down at the end of the week with lawn games and conversation. Bring a picnic blanket and your favourite snack.

events.title: Meet the alumni: career conversations
events.description: Hear how graduates found their first opportunities, then ask your own questions. This sample event demonstrates the careers category.

events.title: Swap shop: give things a second life
events.description: Bring clean, usable books, clothes, or stationery to swap. You are welcome to browse even if you have nothing to bring.
